performance.verdict: Ads never launched; 5 overdue milestones are the real cost.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages were all due 2026-07-31 — now 27 days overdue with no completion recorded.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting were due 2026-08-01 — 26 days overdue; $0 spend and 0 leads recorded across all 28 days.
GBP actions hit 0 for the last 4 consecutive days (Aug 23–26), down from a prior-7d average of ~5/day — a hard stop, not a dip.
GHL shows 101 contacts and 8 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake pipeline exists but is producing no booked consultations.
IG reach fell 11.42% week-over-week and averaged only 749 over the last 3 days vs 762 prior 3 days — flat organic social with no paid amplification.

suggestions.text: Escalate SOW blockers immediately: confirm LSA verification submission and site live status within 48 hours.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are overdue by 26–27 days with no completion event logged; $0 has been spent and 0 leads generated against a ~$6,500/month ad budget. Nacer (Ops) must confirm LSA verification submission status and site/landing page live status by 2026-08-29. Success check: completion events logged in the system and LSA dashboard shows 'in review' or better by that date.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP 4-day zero-action streak; check for listing suspension or ownership issue before any paid launch.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for 4 consecutive days (Aug 23–26) after averaging roughly 5 actions/day in the prior period — a 100% drop that signals a potential listing suspension or verification lapse, not seasonal noise. Sohib should log into the GBP dashboard and confirm listing status immediately. Success check: GBP actions return above 2/day within 7 days, confirmed by 2026-09-03.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 8 opportunities created, 0 appointments booked — identify where leads are stalling in the pipeline.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 101 contacts and 8 opportunities with zero appointments booked and zero won — leads are entering the system but no consultations are being scheduled, suggesting a routing, auto-reply, or speed-to-lead failure. Nacer should audit the pipeline stage-by-stage and confirm whether the 5-minute first-contact SLA and booking calendar are operational. Success check: at least 2 appointments booked from existing pipeline contacts by 2026-09-03.
